extensionAttribute.description: Reports whether the system is currently drawing from AC or battery.
extensionAttribute.scriptContentsMac:
#!/bin/zsh
# Updated by SecurityShrimp 2026 # Power Source Extension Attribute # Targets macOS 12 through 26 (Tahoe), Intel and Apple Silicon # pmset -g ps prints "Now drawing from 'AC Power'" or "'Battery Power'". # Desktops without batteries always report "AC Power".
source=$(/usr/bin/pmset -g ps 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/awk -F"'" '/Now drawing/ { print $2; exit }')
echo "<result>${source:-Unknown}</result>"
